entities.name: José Antonio Cotrina
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Antonio Cotrina is a Spanish writer, focused mainly on the fantasy, science fiction and horror genres. He is best known for his novels set in the Between the Lines Universe and for his trilogy, The Cycle of the Red Moon.
